description_en: Queries the daily peak upstream bandwidth of a user
description_zh: 查询用户的每日上行带宽峰值
name: DescribeUpBpsPeakData

parameters.help_en: The start time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 拉流开始时间，UTC格式，StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 拉流结束时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内，且EndTime超过当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable domain-level statistics. Valid values:

on: enables domain-level statistics.
off: returns user-level data. User-level data is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
域名统计开关，取值：

on：开启域名统计级别。
off：用户级别数据。默认统计用户级别数据
parameters.name: domain_switch

DescribeUpPeakTraffic.description_en: The daily peak upstream bandwidth information
DescribeUpPeakTraffic.description_zh: 每日上行峰值带宽信息

items.description_en: The daily peak upstream bandwidth information
items.description_zh: 每日上行峰值带宽信息

BandWidth.description_zh: 每日峰值上行峰值带宽

PeakTime.description_en: The time when the daily peak upstream bandwidth occurs. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
PeakTime.description_zh: 每日峰值上行带宽的峰值时刻。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

QueryTime.description_en: The queried daily time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
QueryTime.description_zh: 查询的每日时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StatName.description_en: The name of the statistical data attribute. If DomainSwitch is set to on, the live streaming domain name of the user is displayed. If DomainSwitch is set to off or is not specified, the user ID is displayed
StatName.description_zh: 计数据属性名称。当DomainSwitch取值为on时，显示用户直播域名；为off或者不传值是显示用户Id
